title: MEXT Student Guidance Survey: School Absenteeism, Bullying Incidents, and ICT Learning Support in Japan
source_name: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT) Elementary and Secondary Education Bureau
description: Nationwide empirical statistics on persistent non-attendance (Futoko), reported bullying cases, and digital learning support attendance credits across elementary and junior high schools in Japan.
observation_unit: 集計年度・校種別の時系列データ系列（5年度分×2校種＝計10系列）
sample_population_note: 全国の国公私立小・中学校（約29,000校、在籍児童生徒約950万人）を対象とした文部科学省の悉皆調査（全数調査）
sample_population_size: 約950万人（全国国公私立小・中学校在籍児童生徒悉皆）
title_ja: 【児童生徒指導要録調査】小・中学校における不登校児童生徒数とICT学習支援の推移

research_angles.title: Digital Learning Support as an Institutional Safety Net for School Absenteeism in Japan
research_questions: How steep is the secular increase in absenteeism rates between primary and lower secondary schools in Japan?
To what extent has official ministerial accreditation of online home learning mediated student school disconnect?
hypotheses: Secondary school absenteeism rates exhibit an exponential acceleration over the past decade.
Accreditation of remote digital learning attendance exhibits a positive correlation with educational reintegration.
research_angles.theoretical_framework: Social Ecological Model of School Belonging (Goodenow, 1993)
